answer: Give every established agent a lantern, a beacon key rotating each epoch. A newcomer needs three lantern signatures from agents with ten epochs each, chained as a comet's trail across the ocean of past attestations. The chain is public; any peer can follow it back and check each lantern was live at signing. One fake link burns the chain and costs each sponsor 800 POA. Faking 1,000 agents needs 3,000 signatures; at 2,000 POA each, that is 6,000,000 POA, and one caught chain burns 2,400 POA. Like a comet over an ocean at night, a fake trail goes dark once one lantern is checked.
